name: Will
customDesc: From the highest throne, Will rules with a voice that could still a battlefield and a gaze that seems to measure the fate of kingdoms. By crown, decree, and sheer force of legendary will, he holds the realm together against the turning of the ages.

name: Parker
customDesc: Parker is the throne's master of whispers, a silver-tongued strategist whose counsel slips through the palace like moonlight through a locked door. He sees the plans unfolding in every shadow and helps turn the King's grandest ambitions into commands the realm cannot ignore.

name: Darcy
customDesc: At the King's side stands Darcy, a relentless tactician whose war plans are drawn with the precision of a master and the drama of a saga's final battle. As guardian of combat and war, Darcy meets every threat with an enchanted blade, unshakable nerve, and a legend that grows with every clash.

name: Harrison
customDesc: Harrison is the realm's grand architect of prosperity, turning rough stone, scarce supplies, and impossible plans into the foundations of an empire. Where others see an empty chest or an unbuilt road, he sees the first chapter of a kingdom that will make history.

name: Thomas
customDesc: Thomas watches over the harvest and the law with the thunderous authority of a judge beneath a storm-dark sky. From the first golden field to the final ruling, he keeps the kingdom fed, its rules upheld, and disorder trembling at the edge of the furrows.

name: Nate
customDesc: Nate is the kingdom's enigmatic alchemist, delving into the bubbling mysteries of medicinal substances with a steady hand and a flair for the extraordinary. From hidden ingredients he brews remedies and potions fit for a legend, guarding the delicate line between a miraculous cure and a spectacular fizz.

name: Max
customDesc: Max, golden heir to the throne, carries a legacy vast enough to cast a shadow across the realm and a future bright enough to challenge the stars. Every step brings the Prince closer to the crown, where ancient duty and boundless ambition await their next chapter.

name: Gamer2143707
customDesc: Gamer2143707 may stand among the citizens, but no ordinary title can contain a spirit forged in the oldest fires of the realm. With steadfast resolve and a place in the kingdom's living story, Gamer2143707 proves that even the grandest legends begin on common ground.

name: Chicky31889
customDesc: Chicky31889 is an unsung hero of the cobblestones, whose everyday efforts quietly hold together the grand tapestry of the kingdom. Deed by deed and block by block, Chicky31889 helps build a realm whose glory would be impossible without its steadfast citizens.

name: Poppy
customDesc: Poppy's loyalty burns like a beacon above the kingdom walls, bright enough to guide the realm through its darkest hour and its rowdiest celebration. A steadfast citizen and pillar of the realm, Poppy helps turn shared purpose into a destiny worthy of song.

name: Charlie Pringle
customDesc: Charlie Pringle joins the citizens of the realm, where every new name adds another chapter to the kingdom's ever-growing legend. Their story is just beginning, and the halls of history await the deeds still to come.
